dataInvariants: INVARIANT-DATA-001: Every Project Roster row belongs to exactly one Project.
INVARIANT-DATA-002: Operational Driver/Truck intake originates from Project workflows.
INVARIANT-DATA-003: Global registries are derived, never primary operational intake.
INVARIANT-DATA-005: Historical pricing snapshots are immutable.
INVARIANT-DATA-006: A secondary UI entry point cannot create a parallel data model.
INVARIANT-DATA-007: Project authorization is required for project-scoped writes.

targetFirestoreStructure./projects/{projectId}/roster/{rosterId}: Project Roster rows linking carrier, driver, truck, material
targetFirestoreStructure./projects/{projectId}/trips/{tripId}: Live trip state and immutable snapshots
targetFirestoreStructure./projects/{projectId}/imports/{importId}: Batch import audit and review operations
targetFirestoreStructure./users/{userId}: Global user identity and approval state
